description: Column pinning in the Svelte 5 data grid. A wide eight-column grid pins Company to the left and Unit price to the right through initialColumnPinning, so they stay sticky while the middle columns scroll under them; the header menu offers Pin to left, Pin to right and Unpin, and api.setColumnPinning does the same from code. Pinning works with column virtualization on, so a wide grid still renders only the columns in view plus the pinned ones.

faq.question: How do I pin a column on mount?
faq.answer: Pass initialColumnPinning={{ left: ['company'], right: ['price'] }} to <SvGrid>. Users can change it later from each header's menu, and api.setColumnPinning({ left, right }) sets it from code.

faq.question: Does pinning work with column virtualization?
faq.answer: Yes. Pinned cells use position: sticky, so they have to stay in the DOM; the grid renders the pinned-left columns, the virtual window and the pinned-right columns as separate runs, with a spacer cell for the columns between them. A 1,000-column grid with both edges pinned renders about twenty cells per row, not a thousand.

faq.question: Can pinned columns be resized?
faq.answer: Yes. columnResize is on in this demo and works on pinned columns like any other; the pinned edge keeps its position while the column grows.
